detail: National Data Library preview exposes four physical Hillingdon LBSM rows with UPRN/SCU_ID/OS_TOPO_TOID and row coordinates. All four preview coordinates are outside the authoritative title-boundary:33071999 bbox. No target row, actual building Polygon/MultiPolygon, fixed-partition canonical_parcel_id binding, or official EA DTM/DSM raster pixels/zonal statistics were fabricated. Prior Round41 records.geojson also failed physical JSON parse and several Round41 sidecars mismatch their actual bytes.
